metadata.dcterms:title: GDHCN Administrative and Operational Framework
metadata.dcterms:creator: World Health Organization, GDHCN Secretariat
metadata.dcterms:abstract: The legal and administrative framework of the WHO Global Digital Health Certification Network (GDHCN): definitions, purpose and scope, principles, the operational framework and Trust Domains, the GDHCN Secretariat and Participants, the Terms of Participation, the Letter of Application, and Annex I, the DDCC Trust Domain.
